sentences.en: I need to tick off these tasks before I can leave work.
sentences.zh: 我需要把这些任务列出来才能下班。

sentences.en: Make sure you tick off all the items on the shopping list.
sentences.zh: 确保你把购物清单上的所有项目都标记出来。

sentences.en: He likes to tick off countries he's visited on a world map.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢在世界地图上标出自己已经去过哪些国家。
